verdict.rationale: Cognee supports fully local/offline execution via Docker for development and testing, a local start_ui() mode requiring no account, and dataset-scoped isolation/permissions preventing cross-contamination. A runtime probe confirms cognee-cli demo loads a bundled sandbox knowledge graph locally, runs recall queries with no LLM key or cloud dependency, then tears it down with forget, demonstrating a real isolated test workflow that never touches production data. missing for 10: an explicit vendor-labeled sandbox-vs-production environment concept or staging/prod promotion workflow beyond dataset isolation and local dev mode
